Essex County 2024 Primary Election Results (Clarity, linked from the Essex County Clerk's Election Results page)

Essex County 2025 Primary Election results (Clarity): no county committee contests
Essex County Clerk Election Results page
N.J.S.A. 19:5-3 (one committeeman and one committeewoman per election district)

notes: The most recent Republican county committee election found is the June 4, 2024 primary: the 2026 primary results have Democratic county committee contests only and the 2025 primary has none. The 2024 results list a 'For Members of the County Committee - <district> (REP)' contest (Vote for 2) only in the 155 of 575 election districts where a Republican filed, and they report no write-in votes, so the other 420 districts have both seats unknown (empty could not be confirmed). Contests do not mark the male or female seat, so seats are labeled 'Member' and statuses are assigned by count. Filled = one of the top two named candidates with at least one vote and no tie for the last winning place. With one named candidate (38 districts) the second seat is unknown. 4 districts had more than two candidates; 0 seats are unknown because of a tie. 2024 results predate NJ's district-level privacy suppression. Precinct names are as printed in the results; federal-only pseudo-precincts are excluded. Appointments after June 2024 are not captured.
